data.name: Abundius
data.gender_notes: Abundius is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘Abundare’ meaning 'to flow abundantly'. In Christianity, Abundius is the name of a Roman martyr who died in the 3rd century AD. He is venerated for his devotion and generosity to the poor. The name Abundius carries the meaning “Plentiful, Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Abundius usually hope their child will grow to embody plentiful, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual abundance and prosperity one can gain through selflessness and dedication to their faith.
data.etymology: Abundius belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Plentiful, Prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abundius total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Abundius, being a Latin derivative name, holds historical ties to the ancient Roman culture. The name represents the Roman virtues of charity, hospitality, and generosity, making it a popular choice among the upper classes in the Roman Catholic Church.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, the name Abundius holds deep spiritual significance as it symbolizes an abundant and generous spirit towards God and the fellow human beings. As a name of a martyr, Abundius represents selflessness and sacrifice in the spirit of Christ. Moreover, his name inspires the faithful to live a life of abundance in all aspects – material, emotional, and spiritual.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Abundius: Abundant blessings, overflowing with God's grace. A name symbolizing the abundant love and generosity of God.
